With the OBD adapter connected, saves a summary of every trip: distance, time, speeds, rpm, engine temperature and fuel. It stays on your head unit; nothing leaves it.
Open maps and music in split screen

When you open Waze, Maps, Spotify or another maps or music app from LiteKia, it opens in one half and your car (3D or on the road) in the other, without the other widgets. Landscape only. Your home screen doesn\'t change: it\'s as you left it when you return.
You can also switch it right there with the arrows button in the bottom corner.

resources.string: Which app on your screen plays %1$s?
High = more frames when spinning, smoother. Only the missing ones are downloaded.
Speed in the style you like (8 styles) · from OBD when connected, otherwise from GPS
Home shortcut to the Workshop (OBD scanner: trouble codes, inspection readiness and sensors)

Plug an ELM327 adapter into the OBD port (under the steering wheel). Classic Bluetooth: pair it in Android Settings → Bluetooth and pick it here. Bluetooth LE: tap Search. Wi-Fi: join its network and type its address.
No paired adapters. Pair yours in Android Settings → Bluetooth (the PIN is usually 1234 or 0000).
Stored: they turned the light on. Pending: seen once and being watched. Permanent: they clear themselves once the car confirms the fix.
Clearing turns the light off but fixes nothing, and resets the monitors: you won\'t pass an inspection until you drive for a few days.
The car didn\'t accept it (try with the engine off and the key on)
Checks what the inspection station does: check engine light off and monitors ready (one pending is allowed).
Your car doesn\'t report the inspection monitors.
A photo of yours behind the whole home screen. Without one, the theme background.
LiteKia\'s own, with the time and your apps. Automatic: on the left when the screen is landscape, at the bottom when it\'s portrait.
To remove a button, tap its x on the bar; to move it, drag it. Settings always stays.
Apps on the bar, in order. Tap the x to remove one; search below to add one.
Your car in 3D; spin it with your finger and tap to make it big
Your car on the road with your speed (OBD or GPS), trip distance and your tires
A photo of yours, like your brand\'s logo; without one, the LiteKia logo
Pick it from your gallery: each image widget has its own. LiteKia doesn\'t include brand logos.
Without a photo the LiteKia logo is shown.
What\'s playing, with controls; tap to open it big
Opens the dialer or the calling app you choose
Any installed app, one tap away
When LiteKia opens, the LiteKia logo builds itself or your image (like your brand\'s logo) shows for a few seconds. It\'s separate from the image widgets.
Without an image, the LiteKia logo builds itself.
A car reading over OBD: rpm, engine temperature, fuel, battery, economy, boost, throttle or oil
Tap to choose what to show
What do you want to see?
Read by the OBD adapter (connect it in the Workshop). To change it later, tap the gauge.
Distance with check engine light on
Warns on your home screen if the engine overheats or the battery isn\'t charging. While on, the adapter checks temperature, voltage and rpm.
Engine overheating (%1$s). Pull over safely and turn it off.
The battery isn\'t charging (%1$s with the engine running). Check the alternator or belt.
Voltage too high (%1$s). Check the alternator: it can damage the battery.
Low battery (%1$s). It may be hard to start.
No Bluetooth LE adapter found. Make sure it\'s plugged into the car with the engine or ignition on.
Drives the Day and night theme and the night brightness. Sunset time works on any screen; the light sensor notices tunnels and parking garages; the car headlights are learned from your head unit.
This head unit has no light sensor.
Bluetooth is off: turn it on above.
On this Android version, searching Bluetooth LE needs location turned on.
Android didn\'t allow searching right now. Wait a few seconds and try again.
Every head unit reports headlights its own way: LiteKia learns it by comparing its settings with the lights off and on. Without a signal it falls back to sunrise and sunset.
The headlight signal hasn\'t been learned yet.
Noted with the headlights off. Now turn them on and tap Done.
Several settings changed; pick the headlight one (try one; if it doesn\'t work, learn again):
No setting changed: this head unit doesn\'t report the headlights (or writes it late). Try again, waiting a few seconds with the lights on.
The head unit\'s Bluetooth is off.
Pair your phone with this head unit to play its music, or forget it when you want. Music is controlled from the big music widget.
Your head unit pairs the phone from its own Bluetooth app.
Which app on your head unit plays music from your phone?
Title and artist come from your head unit; if they don\'t show, its Bluetooth app doesn\'t send them.
To find and pair phones, LiteKia needs Bluetooth permission (nearby scan and pairing).

The FM radio app that comes with your screen: LiteKia controls it from the Radio widget (play, next, previous and opening it).
Stations near you by GPS and worldwide, with favorites. Needs internet; without it, use your screen\'s radio.

Connect your OBD adapter in the Workshop (with the OBD module on).
